name: Political instability
value: No G20 collapse; Indonesia probe continues
summary: Indonesia's wiretapping probe of police generals continues; no G20 government collapse, coup or contested election
state: Indonesia has arrested four senior police officers, including former police chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo, over alleged wiretapping of President Prabowo, and on 9 Nov said it may sweep the palace for listening devices (Indonesia Business Post). Officials have described the case as potentially treason and it has strained ties with former president Joko Widodo (The Jakarta Post, 5 Nov). No G20 government collapse, coup or contested election was found in the past month as of 11 Nov.
for_you: No direct effect on UK residents. Anyone travelling to Indonesia can check FCDO travel advice for current guidance.
